title: Erosion-susceptibility prioritisation of Sichang Island (Gulf of Thailand): data, scripts and remote evaluation
description: Data, code and remote-evaluation records for the erosion-susceptibility prioritisation of Sichang Island, upper Gulf of Thailand. The package contains the 41 ranking units (29 complete sea-outlet basins and 12 coastal faces), RUSLE factor and soil-loss rasters, Index of Connectivity rasters for four weightings, Monte Carlo results, Sentinel-2 bare-soil frequency and nearshore turbidity data, blind interpretations of 405 random points and two independent erosion-feature inventories (interpreters anonymised), all Python and Google Earth Engine scripts, and the assets of the public Earth Engine application (https://sichang-island.projects.earthengine.app/view/sichang-erosion).
